item.title: The C3 Growth Exchange — Tue Aug 25, 12:00 PM
item.description:
Montclair Business Networking The C3 Growth Exchange Clarity, Strategy & Momentum — In Every Session
Feeling stuck, stretched, or unsure of your next best move? You’re not alone—and you don’t have to figure it out on your own.
The C3 Growth Exchange is a free, high-impact, one-hour virtual session designed for founders and business leaders who want real progress—not just ideas. Each session blends peer insight with expert facilitation to help you move from uncertainty to action.
What to Expect: • Live, supportive discussion with other growth-minded business owners • Practical guidance on your biggest challenges - from strategy to execution • Fresh perspective and real-time problem solving • Clear next steps you can implement immediately • Connection with like-minded professionals
Come with a challenge. Leave with clarity and momentum. \- When: 4th Tuesday of every month \- Time: 12:00 – 1:00 PM \(ET\) \- Cost: Free\, Registration Required\, Limited Seating

item.title: Bobby Jo Valentine Concert at Union Congregational Church — Thu Aug 27, 7:00 PM — Union Congregational Church
item.description: On Thursday, August 27 at 7:00 PM, Union Congregational Church will host Bobby Jo Valentine, a queer, progressive, faith-based folk singer-songwriter, for an evening of music and stories. A longtime friend of the United Church of Christ, Bobby Jo describes himself as an “explorative, hopeful, spiritual, queer artist who strives to make music and poetry that is good medicine for everyone.” He has performed at UCC General Synod and at churches and communities across the country, won multiple awards for his songwriting, and given a TEDx Talk. At the heart of his work is a belief in the soft and steady power of everyday acts of love to heal our world. This concert is an extension of Union Congregational Church’s Open and Affirming commitment; everyone is welcome. item.title: Watchung Booksellers Hosts Crime Novelist James Queally — Thu Aug 27, 7:00 PM — Watchung Booksellers
item.description: Watchung Booksellers welcomes James Queally, author of Surviving the Lie, the third in his Russell Avery series of crime novels. The event will be held in store on Thursday, August 27 at 7:00 p.m. In Surviving the Lie, the final installment of this “turnpike noir” crime series, retired journalist turned private investigator Russell Avery finds himself at odds with a violent band of conspiracy theorists and ex-cops convinced that reporters are the “enemy of the people.” Face-to-face with an America where facts are more fluid than Newark’s Passaic River, he must decide if the truth is still worth fighting for. In addition to authoring the Russell Avery series, James Queally is a Pulitzer prize-winning criminal justice reporter for the Los Angeles Times and has covered crime and police news for the Star-Ledger in New Jersey. Tickets are $5 and include a 10% discount on the book purchased at the event. For more information and to purchase, visit watchungbooksellers.com. Share this:

item.title: Awakening Awareness: Embracing This Moment — Tue Sep 1, 9:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream Feel free to join as we get still and practise presence within this moment. We will discuss and observe the obstacles that, seemingly, block us from being present and bring awareness to our unconsciousness in a safe, inclusive and affirming way.
Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teaching and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous.
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys has been passionate about mindfulness since 2010 and since 2021 he has been organising free, weekly online meditation groups. For more information on his free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group, visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/).
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation (15 minutes) — Wed Sep 2, 11:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Theme of the Month Book Club — Thu Oct 8, 6:30 PM — Montclair Main - Tower Room
item.description:
Looking for new books to discover and fellow readers to connect with? Join Theme of the Month Book Club, a monthly gathering where participants read a book of their choice based on a shared theme and come together to discuss their selections.
Each month, a new theme will be announced—such as historical fiction, books by debut authors, found family, travel, mysteries, and more! Rather than everyone reading the same title, participants are free to choose any book that fits the theme and share their thoughts with the group.
This relaxed and welcoming book club is a great way to broaden your reading horizons, discover new recommendations, and enjoy lively conversations with other book lovers.
Please register to reserve your spot!
Themes:
September: Fresh Starts
October: Banned Books
November: Gratitude and Gathering
December: Home for the Holidays
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306
